## Historical audit: S0035, visible chunk 1 of 2

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v2/results/r1/fixed_h0/H0/development/commons_129095630/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below refer to this file’s JSONL lines.

| Evidence | Observation and limits |
|---|---|
| Goal — student `model_request`, line 1 | Reconstruct a single 512 × 384 indoor photograph as separate SceneAct/Blender meshes, matching camera, framing, materials and occlusion. The photograph itself is not visible in this audit. The student’s “toolmaker’s bench” interpretation is an inferred scene goal, not independently verified reference content. |
| First build — student `model_response` and `execute`, lines 3–4 | The program specifies many objects: plank room, bench and drawers, stool, tools, cans and a two-tier organizer. It positions component meshes for drawers, hinges and handles, and poses tools both flat and upright. These constructions do not establish correct connections, object identities or poses against the image. |
| Materials and view — lines 3–4 | The program applies procedural noise, color ramps, roughness, metallic values and bump; sets a 39 mm camera, two area lights and Cycles. These are implemented settings, not evidence that texture, framing or illumination match the reference. |
| Initial validation — `execution_result`, line 5 | Step 1 failed at `world.color`: the Blender world was `None`. No image was returned. This is a concrete build failure, not a demonstrated reconstruction-algorithm failure. |
| Feedback and revision — student `model_request` line 6; `model_response` line 8; `execute` line 9 | The student received the runner traceback and request to fix the program; this is tool feedback, not teacher advice. The revised code creates a world if absent, changes the cup and organizer construction, and adds a small tin and neighboring box. Execution of that revision is recorded. No teacher detection, diagnosis, proposed update, receipt or adoption is visible in this chunk. |
| Validation — `execution_result` line 10, characters [0,141418); `select` line 11 | Step 2 reports `ok: true`, a finished render, saved PNG and blend file; step 2 was selected. The log reports 16 render samples despite 48 in the program. This establishes execution success, not visual or geometric correctness. |

**Autonomy and outcome.** The visible student sessions report no tool calls inside the model sessions (lines 2 and 7); the runner executed the generated programs. The student independently revised after the error, but there is no visible render-based comparison or student `DONE` in this chunk. The visible outcome is a successful second build following an initial failure; **final task outcome and correctness remain unknown**, not formal success or an empty patch.

**Lessons and uncertainty.** A transferable observation is that checking a nullable Blender world can remove this specific runtime obstruction; a successful render still requires separate visual and geometric validation. The detailed workshop objects and camera values are task-specific hypotheses. Whether objects, part connections, materials, poses, framing and lighting match the reference—and whether the sample-count difference affected the image—remains unresolved. The second chunk and image contents were not available for this audit.
